name: Sana R. Rupani
tagline: Top rated Family Law attorney in Houston, Texas
about: Sana R. Rupani is a seasoned family law attorney with a strong litigation background, exceptional negotiation skills, and a deep commitment to client-centered advocacy. She brings nearly a decade of experience guiding clients through complex legal matters including high-asset divorces, child custody disputes, modifications, and pre/post-nuptial agreements.

Recognized for her compassionate approach and meticulous attention to detail, Sana is also a skilled Guardian ad Litem who prioritizes the best interests of children in high-conflict cases. Her ability to navigate emotionally charged legal matters with professionalism and discretion has earned her the trust of clients and colleagues alike.
Sana is a sought-after speaker at continuing legal education seminars, frequently presenting on topics such as Guardian ad Litem investigations, case law updates, and best practices in family law.

Sana was born and raised in Sugar Land, Texas before moving to Atlanta, Georgia for college and law school. She is excited to be back in Houston, Texas and working with the team at Myres & Associates.
Sana is fluent in Hindi, Urdu, and Gujarati and a first generation Pakistani-American.
Sana lives in Montrose with her husband and mini-goldendoodle. Sana loves going to music festivals, trying new restaurants, and spending time by the pool with her family and friends.
